title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE PROMOTION OF TRADITIONAL MARTIAL ARTS ACT

ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE PROMOTION OF TRADITIONAL MARTIAL ARTS ACT
Consolidated English translation draft based on Korean source version 285989 (KR:010940)

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Promotion of Traditional Martial Arts Act and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Basic Plan for the Promotion of Traditional Martial Arts)
(1) "Matters prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 3 (2) 8 of the Promotion of Traditional Martial Arts Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means the following matters: <Amended on May 12, 2026>
1. Criteria and procedures for designating traditional martial arts for promotion;
2. Directions for developing and supporting traditional martial arts organizations;
3. Other matters relating to the promotion of traditional martial arts.
(2) When the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism establishes a basic plan under Article 3 of the Act, the Minister shall notify the Mayor of a Special City or Metropolitan City, a provincial governor, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, and the head of each city, county, or autonomous district thereof. <Amended on May 12, 2026>

Article 3 (Scope and Methods of Surveys on Traditional Martial Arts)
(1) The scope of surveys on traditional martial arts conducted under Article 5 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "surveys") shall be as follows:
1. The status of traditional martial arts disciplines and organizations;
2. The status of traditional martial arts instructors;
3. The status of traditional martial arts education;
4. The status of traditional martial arts competitions;
5. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism for establishing and implementing policies to promote traditional martial arts.
(2) The Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism may commission an institution or organization possessing expertise in traditional martial arts or survey activities to conduct surveys.

Article 4 (Grades of Traditional Martial Arts Instructors, etc.)
(1) Traditional martial arts instructors shall be divided into Grade 1 and Grade 2. <Amended on May 12, 2026>
(2) A Grade 1 traditional martial arts instructor shall be a person who falls under any of the following subparagraphs and has passed the qualification examination and completed the training course specified and publicly notified by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism: Provided, That a person recognized as a holder of national intangible heritage in a martial arts discipline under the Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Heritage shall be deemed to have acquired Grade 1 qualification as a traditional martial arts instructor. <Amended on March 25, 2016 and May 7, 2024>
1. A person with at least two years of competitive or coaching experience in the discipline for which qualification is sought after acquiring Grade 2 qualification as a traditional martial arts instructor;
2. A person recognized by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism as possessing qualifications equal to or higher than those of a person under subparagraph 1.
(3) A Grade 2 traditional martial arts instructor shall be a person who falls under any of the following subparagraphs and has passed the qualification examination and completed the training course specified and publicly notified by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism: Provided, That a person recognized as a transmission educator of national intangible heritage in a martial arts discipline under the Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Heritage shall be deemed to have acquired Grade 2 qualification as a traditional martial arts instructor. <Amended on March 25, 2016; November 3, 2020; and May 7, 2024>
1. A person who has completed the courses and credits specified and publicly notified by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism at any of the following educational institutions:
   (a) A school under Article 2 of the Higher Education Act;
   (b) A lifelong education institution under subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Lifelong Education Act;
2. A person who has obtained a certificate of qualification from a traditional martial arts organization specified and publicly notified by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism;
3. A person who has obtained a certificate of completion of transmission education for national intangible heritage in a martial arts discipline under the Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Heritage;
4. A person recognized by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism as possessing qualifications equal to or higher than those of a person under subparagraph 1.

Article 5 (Support for Education in Traditional Martial Arts)
(1) "Projects prescribed by Presidential Decree, including education and the development of professional personnel" in Article 12 of the Act means the following projects:
1. Development and operation of traditional martial arts education programs;
2. Development and dissemination of educational materials on traditional martial arts;
3. Installation and improvement of facilities for traditional martial arts education;
4. Purchase of traditional martial arts education equipment;
5. Development of professional personnel;
6. Other projects deemed necessary by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism for transmitting and developing traditional martial arts.
(2) The Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism may, within budgetary limits, provide the necessary expenses to persons carrying out any of the projects specified in paragraph (1).

Article 6 (Entrustment or Performance on Behalf of the Minister of Projects Supporting Competitions and International Exchanges)
(1) "Relevant institutions or organizations prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 13 (2) of the Act means any of the following institutions or organizations:
1. The UNESCO International Centre of Martial Arts established under Article 9 (1) of the Act;
2. The Korea Sports Promotion Foundation under Article 36 (1) of the National Sports Promotion Act;
3. The Taekwondo Promotion Foundation under Article 20 (1) of the Act on the Promotion of Taekwondo and Creation of Taekwondo Park;
4. A nonprofit corporation established pursuant to Article 32 of the Civil Act, which the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism recognizes as having the capacity to carry out projects relating to the promotion of traditional martial arts.
(2) Where the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism entrusts any institution or organization specified in paragraph (1) with projects under Article 13 (1) of the Act or has such an institution or organization perform the projects on the Minister's behalf, the Minister shall publicly announce the institution or organization entrusted or acting on behalf of the Minister, and the projects concerned, on the website of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 21365, March 25, 2009>
This Decree shall enter into force on March 29, 2009.

ADDENDA <Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Cultural Heritage; Presidential Decree No. 27056, March 25, 2016>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on March 28, 2016.
Article 2 Omitted.
Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) through (8) Omitted.
(9) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Promotion of Traditional Martial Arts Act is amended as follows:
In the proviso to the part of Article 3 (2) other than its subparagraphs, "important intangible cultural heritage of a martial arts discipline under the Cultural Heritage Protection Act" shall be replaced by "national intangible cultural heritage of a martial arts discipline under the Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Cultural Heritage"; in the proviso to the part of Article 3 (3) other than its subparagraphs, "transmission education assistant of important intangible cultural heritage of a martial arts discipline under the Cultural Heritage Protection Act" shall be replaced by "transmission education assistant of national intangible cultural heritage of a martial arts discipline under the Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Cultural Heritage".
(10) through (14) Omitted.
Article 4 Omitted.

ADDENDA <Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Cultural Heritage; Presidential Decree No. 31138, November 3, 2020>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on December 10, 2020.
Article 2 Omitted.
Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) and (2) Omitted.
(3) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Promotion of Traditional Martial Arts Act is amended as follows:
In the proviso to the part of Article 3 (3) other than its subparagraphs, the term "transmission education assistant" shall be replaced by "transmission educator"; subparagraph 3 of the same paragraph shall be replaced by the following:
3. A person who has obtained a certificate of completion of transmission education for national intangible cultural heritage in a martial arts discipline under the Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Cultural Heritage.
(4) and (5) Omitted.

ADDENDA <Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Heritage; Presidential Decree No. 34492, May 7, 2024>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on May 17, 2024.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) through (10) Omitted.
(11) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Promotion of Traditional Martial Arts Act is amended as follows:
In the proviso to the part of Article 3 (2) other than its subparagraphs, "Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Cultural Heritage" shall be replaced by "Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Heritage", and "national intangible cultural heritage" by "national intangible heritage".
In the proviso to the part of Article 3 (3) other than its subparagraphs and subparagraph 3 of the same paragraph, "Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Cultural Heritage" shall be replaced by "Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Intangible Heritage", and "national intangible cultural heritage" by "national intangible heritage".
(12) through (15) Omitted.
Article 3 Omitted.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 36323, May 12, 2026>
This Decree shall enter into force on May 12, 2026.
